kill_challenges.location: Inside the cafe at the town square, berating a subordinate.
kill_challenges.challenge: Kill Philo Beck with a Rat Bomb.
kill_challenges.strategy: Grab the Rat Bomb on the 2nd-floor landing of the ruined house near the riverbed. Sneak behind the bar counter while Beck steps away, plant the bomb on the floor outline, and retreat.

kill_challenges.location: Patrolling the harbor docks across the river.
kill_challenges.challenge: Kill Claude La Ronde with cargo.
kill_challenges.strategy: Take position across the river via the eastern train tracks. Wait until La Ronde walks directly under the suspended construction materials, then shoot the crane winch.

kill_challenges.location: Patrolling the lower walkway platform along the massive dam.
kill_challenges.challenge: Kill Ludwig Spiegel by making him fall from the dam.
kill_challenges.strategy: Shoot the walkway support beams from a distance while he stands on the platform to collapse it, or lure/incapacitate him to the upper dam railing and throw his body over.

kill_challenges.location: Large cabin in the northern sector near the U-boat facility.
kill_challenges.challenge: Kill Eloi Coste with an LMG.
kill_challenges.strategy: Pacify or incapacitate Coste, grab the MG42 located in the second-floor bedroom, and finish him off with it while he is downed.

kill_challenges.location: Mansion located in the western sector of the town.
kill_challenges.challenge: Kill Uwe Schoene with a Coal Torpedo.
kill_challenges.strategy: Collect the Coal Torpedo from the ground-floor supply room. Sneak to the 2nd-floor fireplace undetected, rig the fuel basket, and wait for him to ignite it.

kill_challenges.location: Farmhouse on the western edge of the facility.
kill_challenges.strategy: Acquire the poison bottle from the laboratory shelf, tamper with his designated drink cup/flask on the kitchen counter, and wait for him to drink.

kill_challenges.location: Northern depot yard inspecting machinery and fuel canisters.
kill_challenges.challenge: Kill Hermann Gottschalk with a gas explosion.
kill_challenges.strategy: Wait for Gottschalk to patrol adjacent to the red pressurized fuel pumps, then fire rifle rounds into the pump cylinder until it detonates.
